{3: "On the way back to the Wanderer's Lodge, Karenina mumbles incoherently from behind you."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "Commandant... I can walk on my own. The way back to... that lodge is pretty far, isn't it?", 4: '1', 18: '100019911'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Don't let this fool you... The Engineering Force... we've had proper training, you know!", 4: '1', 18: '100019912'}
{2: "I'm not tired at all.", 3: '12'}
{3: "In a way, you are glad she was the one who drank the mermaid's tears. Otherwise, having her drag you back would have been pretty rough."}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Hmph, that's not it. You're just doing this... to piss me off... aren't you?", 4: '1', 18: '100019914'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'This is kinda... nice. Reminds me of when I was little... Grandpa would carry me home on his back... No matter where I hid...', 4: '1', 18: '100019915'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "He would always find me... Mm... I'm really strong now, Grandpa.", 4: '1', 18: '100019916'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Commandant, let's just go ahead with the performance!", 4: '1', 18: '100019917'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "When that happens, we'll totally... dazzle everyone, you know? We will, right?", 4: '1', 18: '100019918'}
{2: "I thought you didn't want to participate.", 3: '28', 4: 'Sure.', 5: '32'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Hmph, you idiot... You don't get it at all.", 4: '1', 18: '100019919'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "When I said I didn't want to go, couldn't you... have... tried a little harder to convince me?", 4: '1', 18: '100019930'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "After all... I really wanted to... be with you too... Mmh, it's so hot... Oh, why's it so cold now?", 4: '1', 18: '100019941'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Mm... Why didn't you... ask me about it?", 4: '1', 18: '100019952'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "If you'd just asked, I would've... considered it right away!", 4: '1', 18: '100019957'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "In the end, you're an idiot, 【kuroname】... and I'm a coward.", 4: '1', 18: '100019958'}
{2: "You're not a coward.", 3: '38', 4: "I'm not an idiot.", 5: '38', 6: 'Yeah, that sounds about right.', 7: '38'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Even if I went, I'd probably just... No, I don't want to fail.", 4: '1', 18: '100019959'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Once we're back on the surface, everything will go back to normal. When that happens—", 4: '1', 18: '100019960'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "You'll forget all this too, Commandant. Things that aren't real... they'll never be real, no matter what...", 4: '1', 18: '100019961'}
{3: "Sensing Karenina's mood has dipped because of the performance, you try to come up with a solution..."}
{3: 'But she is already fast asleep by the time you have an answer. You hear her steady breathing behind you, and she sounds completely carefree.'}
{3: 'The evening breeze stirs her bangs, tickling where they rest against your neck. Her body temperature seems to be running a bit higher than usual.'}
{3: "If it weren't for this place, you'd probably never see her be so open and honest about her feelings."}
{3: "Yet another memory stirs somewhere deep in Karenina's M.I.N.D., and she remembers something that happened long ago."}

{1: '1', 3: 'Having completed several brutal deadlines, Karenina is yawning incessantly when Bianca arrives with a new flavor of pseudo-caffeine electrolyte solution.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Who would've thought I'd actually gotten used to this stuff lately... This tasteless, bitter drink.", 4: '1', 18: '100019963'}
{3: 'Karenina tips her head back and downs most of the electrolyte drink in one go, musing to herself.'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: "You've been having a bit too much caffeine lately, you know.", 4: '2', 18: '100019964'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'Rest is still the best remedy when your M.I.N.D. is exhausted.', 4: '2', 18: '100019965'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "There's never enough time! One damn deadline after another... I haven't even finished the old missions, and new ones keep sprouting up like weeds!", 4: '1', 18: '100019966'}
{3: 'Karenina lets herself sink into the pile of books, trying to relax for just a moment.'}

{2: 'Bianca', 3: "Oh, I nearly forgot to congratulate you. I heard you're being promoted from demolition team leader to Engineering Force Captain. That's record-breaking time for a promotion.", 4: '2', 18: '100019967'}
{3: "Karenina looks up, accepting the good news with a calmness she didn't expect. She thought she'd be happier about it, but she isn't."}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Hmph... It's not like it was a surprise.", 4: '1', 18: '100019968'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "The transfer orders should be coming through soon, but... it still doesn't feel real.", 4: '1', 18: '100019969'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Being captain won't make things any easier. I'll just have more problems to deal with.", 4: '1', 18: '100019970'}
{3: 'Bianca picks up her coffee and takes a small sip, her gaze turning to Karenina with quiet warmth.'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: "I don't worry about you, Karenina.", 4: '2', 18: '100019971'}

{2: 'Bianca', 3: "Learning anything new always comes with growing pains. But once you push through and it becomes second nature, boredom will set in, and you'll start craving the next challenge.", 4: '2', 18: '100019972'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'Neither humans nor Constructs can ever be satisfied with the status quo. That restless drive... I suppose that is the essence of life itself.', 4: '2', 18: '100019973'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "...Thanks. I'll just take that as a compliment, Bianca.", 4: '1', 18: '100019974'}
{1: ' ', 2: 'Bianca', 3: 'Sometimes I truly envy that unstoppable drive of yours. No matter the obstacle, it simply shatters the moment it encounters you.', 4: '2', 18: '100019975'}
{3: 'Bianca lowers her voice slightly, her gentle tone carrying an inexplicable edge.'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: "Though... you haven't read that book I lent you recently, have you?", 4: '2', 18: '100019976'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Ngh... That's not true! I read it... I read some of it!", 4: '1', 18: '100019977'}
{3: 'Bianca shifts her gaze from her companion back to the page with an expression of calm insight.'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'You read a dozen pages before drowsiness kicked in... then you left it sitting on your desk, until you remembered it right before our meeting today.', 4: '2', 18: '100019978'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'So you pulled up a summary from the database and skimmed through it hastily. Am I right?', 4: '2', 18: '100019979'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Y-yeah, pretty much. But I think that book's got problems anyway.", 4: '1', 18: '100019980'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: "Oh? I'd like to hear your take on it.", 4: '2', 18: '100019981'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Mmm... You sure? Fair warning: I haven't read a ton of classics like you have, so don't expect anything profound or eloquent.", 4: '1', 18: '100019982'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: "That's okay. I just want to hear what you think, Karenina. There's no judgment involved.", 4: '2', 18: '100019983'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "I think the protagonist's got problems. She had responsibilities, but she dropped everything and left the moment she got other ideas.", 4: '1', 18: '100019984'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "To me, that's just irresponsible.", 4: '1', 18: '100019985'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'True, she made the wrong choice and crossed the "fence," but I\'ve been thinking... Maybe a life with mistakes is brilliant in its own way.', 4: '2', 18: '100019986'}

{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'Many people in this world live and stay within certain boundaries, no matter what... because at least it\'s safe to live by the book. I call that kind of boundary a "fence."', 4: '2', 18: '100019988'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "If she really wanted to change her life because she was dissatisfied, she should've left her situation and found a job...", 4: '1', 18: '100019989'}
{3: "Bianca can't help but laugh at Karenina's response. After a moment, she composes herself."}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: "Because it's the story of Anna Karenina, not the Engineering Force's Karenina. Given the historical context of that era... No, let's not get sidetracked.", 4: '2', 18: '100019990'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: "You're right. When faced with different choices, people often ignore what they truly want. They lack the courage to break free from the world they know.", 4: '2', 18: '100019991'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: "Of course the protagonist made mistakes. Every choice that wasn't safe was a risk.", 4: '2', 18: '100019992'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'But even a moth drawn to flame deserves recognition for its courage.', 4: '2', 18: '100019993'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'So even knowing it would end in failure, she was still willing to risk it all...', 4: '1', 18: '100019994'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'What a strange kind of courage.', 4: '1', 18: '100019995'}
{3: 'That is what literature does. It explores the gray areas of reality... the third option that exists beyond right and wrong.'}
{3: "Morality or laws could certainly be used to label and judge whether people's actions are right or wrong. But when absolute correctness is demanded in fiction, all possibilities are lost."}
{3: 'Both the characters in the story and those reading it must journey inward, searching until they find their answer.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Bianca', 3: "It's okay if you don't understand right now, Karenina. Maybe not understanding it is a kind of virtue in itself.", 4: '2', 18: '100019996'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'People feel differently about the same work at different points in their lives. Our experiences shape how we see things.', 4: '2', 18: '100019997'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'You really know your stuff when it comes to literature, Bianca...', 4: '1', 18: '100019998'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1176.jpg'}
{1: '1', 3: 'After all this time, Karenina finally has her answer.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: '"I understand it now, Bianca."', 4: '3', 18: '100019999'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: '"About the fence... and courage."', 4: '3', 18: '100020000'}

{2: "Two Days Until the Songstress Trials\\nWanderers' Lodge, Xoth"}
{3: 'Kiki, having returned at dawn after working through the night, stuffs food into her mouth between breaths.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kiki', 3: "Hey, Boss, you're looking pretty rough. Were you even listening to what I just said?", 4: '1', 18: '100020002'}
{3: 'Kiki turns to you with a look that says she needs backup.'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: "Did you guys run into some surprise attack I don't know about? Did Karenina beat them up good?", 4: '1', 18: '100020003'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: 'You know, like how she whips us interns into shape.', 4: '1', 18: '100020004'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Her cap pulled down over most of her face, Karenina slumps to the side, muttering under her breath.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "If she finds out how much of a lightweight I am, I'm done for!", 4: '2', 18: '100020006'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Oh man... Is Thunder Sparks actually cursed or something? Like, a drunk curse?', 4: '2', 18: '100020007'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "I don't wanna end up like Kelly!!!", 4: '2', 18: '100020008'}
{1: '1', 3: "Deerbear and Huhunina perch on her shoulders, eavesdropping on their master's master's thoughts."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kiki', 3: "That's the captain for you. Even her battle debriefs are this thorough.", 4: '1', 18: '100020009'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: 'When will I ever be able to hold my own like her?', 4: '1', 18: '100020010'}
{3: "Pouring Kiki a cup of freshly brewed coffee, you suddenly think that it isn't so bad to have someone idolize you."}
{3: 'Children never realize how chaotic and messy adult lives are.'}
{2: "How's the escape plan coming along?", 3: '196'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kiki', 3: 'Calling it "no progress" would be generous. It\'s bad.', 4: '1', 18: '100020011'}
{2: 'Tell us about it.', 3: '200'}
{3: "Karenina is still barely conscious, and it seems she won't be recovering from the pseudo-alcoholic electrolyte anytime soon, which means you have to pick up the slack."}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory605.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory605.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kiki', 3: 'Right. Like we discussed before, I started walking in one direction, heading straight regardless of any obstacles I encountered.', 4: '18', 18: '100020012'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: 'No matter which direction I went, it all led back to Lycan Street.', 4: '18', 18: '100020013'}

{2: 'Kiki', 3: "I've been thinking about it... The projection must be covering the entire city and hiding the real exits. By using similar landmarks, they've turned this place into one giant, sealed maze.", 4: '18', 18: '100020014'}
{2: "Plan A's a bust.", 3: '213'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory601.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory601.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kiki', 3: 'Next, I climbed to the top of the tallest tower in the city and used an amplifier to boost my signal range.', 4: '18', 18: '100020015'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: 'But the comms got cut off every time I connected to an external source. There must be some serious signal jammers here.', 4: '18', 18: '100020016'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: 'At least I can confirm that comms within this base is running on a pre-designed point-to-point area network, and not an external one.', 4: '18', 18: '100020017'}
{2: "Plan B's a wash too, just as expected.", 3: '222'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory534.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory534.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kiki', 3: 'Last but not least, the demolition plan devised by none other than Boss herself!', 4: '18', 18: '100020018'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: 'I waited for the guard shift around dawn to plant the detonators, but the patrol caught me before I was done.', 4: '18', 18: '100020019'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: 'Which is why I got back so late—', 4: '18', 18: '100020020'}

{2: 'Kiki', 3: 'They hauled me off to a re-education class and made me read the "Xoth Resident Guide for Temporary Residents" over 80 times, and I couldn\'t leave until I scored a perfect grade on their test.', 4: '18', 18: '100020021'}
{2: 'There goes Plan C.', 3: '232'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory731.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory731.jpg'}
{3: 'All your backup plans have gone down in flames. Security this tight means there must have been tons of escape attempts in the past.'}
{3: 'Something is definitely wrong in a city with no exits. Right now, the projection device is still your biggest obstacle.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Actually, there is a Plan D, but...', 4: '1', 18: '100020022'}
{3: 'Karenina has been sitting at the table wrapped in a blanket since the discussion started, but this is the first time she speaks up.'}
{2: "No. That's off the table.", 3: '243'}
{3: 'You know what Karenina is thinking, and you know what it will cost her. But you also know she is determined to do it anyway.'}
{3: 'Which is exactly why you cannot let her go through with it.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "Commandant, you didn't even let me finish!", 4: '1', 18: '100020023'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "This plan isn't as dangerous as you think! If we time it right, it can be our fastest way out of here!", 4: '1', 18: '100020024'}
{2: "No. That isn't even an option.", 3: '252'}
{2: 'Nothing is worth that kind of risk.', 3: '253'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kiki', 3: "What are you two even talking about? I'm totally lost here.", 4: '2', 18: '100020025'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Idiot, the projections Xoth uses work directly via your optic nerves.', 4: '1', 18: '100020026'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'For humans, the projections will still work even if the organs are damaged, as long as the neural pathways are intact. But for Constructs...', 4: '1', 18: '100020027'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: 'Constructs... Oh! Constructs can control their senses at will!', 4: '2', 18: '100020028'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: "You want to shut down your visual module and put it offline. Then you can use your sensory module to feel out the base's actual layout!", 4: '2', 18: '100020029'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: "Absolutely not! I'm with the commandant on this. You know exactly what will happen if you go through with this!", 4: '2', 18: '100020030'}
{2: "It'll cause M.I.N.D. deviation.", 3: '264'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "That will only happen if I shut it down for an extended period! Why won't you guys hear me out on this plan?", 4: '1', 18: '100020031'}
{3: 'You have so much to say, but you are arguing against Karenina and her trademark stubbornness. Unexpectedly, Kiki explodes before you can say a word.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kiki', 3: "No means no! And you're the one who never listens to anyone, Boss!", 4: '2', 18: '100020032'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: "It's because you're important to us! Why can't you see that?!", 4: '2', 18: '100020033'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: 'If something happens to you, how do I face everyone back home?', 4: '2', 18: '100020034'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: "And I'm just an intern... I'm not even worth—", 4: '2', 18: '100020035'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Before Kiki can finish, Karenina shoves a piece of bread into her mouth.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Say something that pitiful again, and I'll really get pissed!", 4: '1', 18: '100020036'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Kiki, I never really asked you... why did you come here?', 4: '1', 18: '100020037'}
{3: 'Kiki fidgets with her fingers, her eyes innocent and clear.'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: "There's... something I didn't tell you, Boss.", 4: '2', 18: '100020038'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: 'You know my research is on amplifiers, right?', 4: '2', 18: '100020039'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Of course I do! I might be too busy to make it to every tech meeting, but I read the weekly reports. I know what my team is working on.', 4: '1', 18: '100020040'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'I guess I should work on my image within the Engineering Force!', 4: '1', 18: '100020041'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "It's physics-based engineering. By adjusting the frequencies, we try to transmit wavelengths at their smallest unit across the maximum possible area.", 4: '1', 18: '100020042'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Think of it like wireless communication. With an amplifier, an area that used to get one bar of signal can jump to receiving five bars.', 4: '1', 18: '100020043'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: "Truth is, I've been stuck on this research for ages. I can't even convince myself the results are good, let alone good enough to pass the evaluation.", 4: '2', 18: '100019920'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Research doesn't work that fast! Getting all worked up about it won't help!", 4: '1', 18: '100019921'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Pull yourself together, Kiki! And snap out of it already!', 4: '1', 18: '100019922'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Research is all about navigating minefields. Trial and error is the only way to find the right path.', 4: '1', 18: '100019923'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "If we wrote off research just because it hasn't produced results yet, there would hardly be any labs in the world.", 4: '1', 18: '100019924'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: "But the projection amplitude in Xoth is really strong! Boss, didn't you feel it?!", 4: '2', 18: '100019925'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "So you think there's research here that aligns with your work!", 4: '1', 18: '100019926'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: "Yeah, I came here to avoid the evaluation at first. But the moment I arrived and discovered this... I didn't want to leave anymore.", 4: '2', 18: '100019927'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: "Even if you dock my pay, issue a formal reprimand, or decide you don't want me anymore, Boss... I still want to see that structure with my own eyes.", 4: '2', 18: '100019928'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: "Even if this whole place gets blown to smithereens, I'll search every inch with a detector until I find it.", 4: '2', 18: '100019929'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: 'I was planning to find the exit, get you and the commandant out safely, then stay behind and keep searching.', 4: '2', 18: '100019931'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: "That's how selfish I am... I'm causing all this trouble just to stay here, so I don't deserve you doing all this for me, Boss!", 4: '2', 18: '100019932'}
{3: "Having finally laid bare everything weighing on her heart, Kiki sheds the grown-up facade she's been wearing."}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Is that what's been eating you up inside? So what if you wanted to stay?! You think knowing that would've stopped us from coming to get you?!", 4: '1', 18: '100019933'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Idiot... you were more scared of me saying no than getting in trouble, weren't you?", 4: '1', 18: '100019934'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Spiraling in your own head, assuming I wouldn't support you... Kiki, at the end of the day, you don't trust me enough!", 4: '1', 18: '100019935'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Forget about me being your captain or your boss. Ngh... If you respect what we do, you should've been honest with me!", 4: '1', 18: '100019936'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: "I know, I know all of that, but I would've lost my chance to stay if you'd said no, Boss. I know how selfish and impatient I was being.", 4: '2', 18: '100019937'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: "A human's life is so short, but my dream feels so impossibly far away... so far that I can't even see the finish line.", 4: '2', 18: '100019938'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Be patient. Rushing won't work.", 4: '1', 18: '100019939'}
{3: 'Now that she fully understands what Kiki has been thinking, Karenina calms down.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "I've known two truly exceptional scientists, both of them human. One was family, and the other... was my teacher!", 4: '1', 18: '100019940'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Their lives weren't any longer than anyone else's, but their dreams reached far beyond.", 4: '1', 18: '100019942'}

{2: 'Karenina', 3: "They accomplished so much in their lifetimes, and we'll accomplish even more. If this is really what you want to go after, I'll support you no matter what.", 4: '1', 18: '100019943'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "And if I didn't believe in you, I wouldn't have traveled all this way to find you. Have a little faith in me... and a little faith in yourself!", 4: '1', 18: '100019944'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "Alright, alright, I get it! I'm going!", 4: '1', 18: '100019945'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "You stay here and rest. We'll talk about it when we get back!", 4: '1', 18: '100019946'}
{3: 'Right before she heads out, Karenina hesitates and turns back to add one more thing.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "Kiki, it takes a lot of courage to be honest, but it's still better than saying nothing and letting misunderstandings pile up.", 4: '1', 18: '100019947'}
